Annales: The True and Royall History of Queen Elizabeth (William Camden, 1615)
==========================================================
Camden's Annales (1615-25) - the reign of Elizabeth I by the antiquary who invented the field; the first 'official' history of the Elizabethan age. The 1625 English translation.
